# ServerSide Plugin

> Block cache, placeholders, viewport fill, AbortSignal/Subscribable contract, child-row fetch protocol, `data-src`. Consumers of `datasource:*` (Tree, GroupingRows) → grid-plugins-hierarchy.md · MultiSort/Filtering `datasource:sort-mode`/`filter-mode` handling (#520/#521) and the row-identity rule → grid-plugins-catalog-data.md · plugin architecture → grid-plugins.md · `requestRender` vs `requestVirtualRefresh` → grid-render-pipeline.md.
>
> Read order for "blank grid / blocks never load": INVARIANT (discardCache → fetchBlock → rebuild rule) → #507 `pendingViewportCheck` → PR #522 `displayDiffers`. For "stale rows after sort/refresh": AbortSignal `DECIDED` → `releaseBlock`. For "child rows stuck loading": #539 in the AbortSignal `DECIDED`.

OWNS: fetch cache, lazy blocks, placeholders (`createLoadingPlaceholder` → `{__loading,__index,__rowCacheKey}`, guard `isLoadingPlaceholder` public), `managedNodes`, `blockControllers: Map<number,AbortController>`, `childControllers`.
HOOKS: processRows(-10) — IGNORES input, returns viewport-clamped `managedNodes`. renderRow(-10) — claims placeholders.
EVENTS: `datasource:data|children|loading|error`; `data.generation` (#538) ++ on every `discardCache()` (GroupingRows merges same-generation blocks). QUERIES: `datasource:fetch-children`, `datasource:is-active`, `datasource:filter-mode` / `datasource:sort-mode` (`'server'|'local'` while a data source is set, else unanswered). LISTENS: `sort-change`, `filter-change`.

- INVARIANT: `totalNodeCount = -1` → infinite scroll; `0` → unknown (malformed/negative total → `0` in `applyServerResult`); short block auto-detects end. `grid.sourceRows` stays empty. EVERY cache discard goes through `discardCache(resetTotal)`: aborts blocks, clears `loadedBlocks`, bumps `#generation`, `managedNodes = []`, resets `pendingViewportCheck` + scroll debounce; `setDataSource`/`onModelChange`/`detach` reset the total, `purgeCache` keeps it (placeholders keep rendering, nothing fetched until the next scroll). `refresh()` = `setDataSource(current)`. `processRows` fills `managedNodes` by walking `loadedBlocks` (O(loaded rows), not O(total)) — valid ONLY because discard pairs `loadedBlocks.clear()` with `managedNodes = []` (uncovered slot ⇒ placeholder). `onModelChange` MUST call `loadRequiredBlocks()` after discard. All root fetches go through `fetchBlock(ds, n, size, enrichment, gridId, initial)`; `initial` = block 0 of `setDataSource`: it skips the sync post-landing `loadRequiredBlocks()` (pre-render window is empty or the previous dataset's; `afterRender` fills — and spec mocks default `_virtualization` to `0..20`, so running it double-fetches) AND is ALWAYS in `needsRowModelRebuild` (PR #579 review): a scroll-started block that lands and renders first sizes `managedNodes`, so block 0 would otherwise take the virtual-refresh path with no viewport check and the slot it frees stays idle until the next settlement. ROOT-block `loading:false` (no `context`) ONLY via `broadcastIdleIfSettled()` (`loadingBlocks.size === 0`; block 0 used to broadcast unconditionally → flicker while a scroll-started block 1 was in flight); child requests emit their own per-request `{loading, context}` pair in `fetchChildren`. Block resolution with `previousManagedLength === 0` OR `detail.claimed` OR `this.rows !== managedNodes` OR `managedNodes.length !== getNodeCount()` (infinite estimate grows by a block / short block shrinks it — `<` totalNodeCount missed both) OR `_virtualization.variableHeights` (loaded rows' heights ≠ placeholder estimates; `refreshVirtualWindow(false)` rebuilds neither position cache nor spacer — PR #525) MUST `requestRender()` + `managedNodes = slice()`. WHY: the in-place swap + `requestVirtualRefresh()` (skips processRows) is visible ONLY while `_rows` IS `managedNodes`; a claiming structural plugin or later stage (local sort/filter) derived `_rows` from old contents, and input-ref caches (Filtering `cachedInputRows`) need a new ref (#520). `loadRequiredBlocks()` → `getRequiredBlockNumbers()` (ascending block SET): structural `datasource:viewport-mapping` range if answered, else 1:1, ±`loadThreshold`, clamped to `knownTotal`. INVARIANT (PR #522): when `displayDiffers` (`this.rows !== managedNodes`, non-empty) display index ≠ node index (local filter/sort; Tree renumbers KEPT roots from zero) → ADD the block of every placeholder in the display window ±threshold via `__index` (`floor`/`ceil` — fractional `loadThreshold`; skip `__index >= knownTotal`). Unanswered mapping + `displayDiffers` → placeholders only. Mocks MUST set `grid.rows = plugin.processRows([])`.
- TENSION: placeholders are allocated eagerly, one object per node (1M rows ⇒ 1M objects in `processRows`' grow loop). Lazy placeholders would break the stable-ref + `__index` contracts downstream (#508 rendering, `__rowCacheKey` height cache). Bench: `datasource.bench.ts` "ServerSidePlugin.processRows".
- DECIDED (#508, PR #511): placeholders never reach consumer callbacks. (a) `renderRow` (priority -10, beats Responsive `cardRenderer`) → `plugins/shared/loading-placeholder.ts#renderLoadingPlaceholderRow` (shared w/ GroupingRows, inlined per bundle): releases cells via `row-teardown.ts#clearRowForRebuild`, one full-width cell + `setRowLoadingState`, class `placeholder-row`; skips rebuild when `__rowDataRef === row`; `__isCustomRow` ⇒ `structureValid=false` so landed data rebuilds. (b) HEIGHT: `style.height = _getPluginRowHeight(row,i)` else `''`, per-row `--tbw-row-height` dropped, synced BEFORE the same-row skip; consumer `rowHeight` skipped for `__loading` in `virtualization-manager` AND `rows.ts`. (c) `tryResolveRowId` → `__loading:<__index>` / `__loading:group:<__groupKey>` before `getRowId`; `__rowCacheKey` for the height cache. (d) opt-out `placeholderRendering: 'columns'` = old cell path. (e) ContextMenu keyboard path returns `false` for them. (f) skipped by Editing `captureBaselines` and Tree `hasChildren`/`detectTreeStructure`; overlay via `setRowLoadingState(el,on,loadingRenderer)` (cells → #515). Tests: `integration/server-side-placeholders.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (Apr 2026): core `applySort`/`grid.sort()` emits `sort-change` to BOTH DOM and plugin bus (`_pluginManager.emitPluginEvent`). WHY: without MultiSort ServerSide misses it.
- DECIDED (#507): post-load viewport fill runs in `afterRender()` via one-shot `pendingViewportCheck`, set when a block takes the `requestRender()` path (incl. block 0) or a `filterMode:'local'` `filter-change` re-renders (rejected rows move placeholders into view without a scroll, PR #522); independent of `loadThreshold`. WHY: a sync `loadRequiredBlocks()` after `requestRender()` reads the PRE-render `_virtualization` / `datasource:viewport-mapping`. The `requestVirtualRefresh()` path does NOT set it (sync; its re-check is current). `discardCache()` resets the flag, else `afterRender` refetches what was just purged (PR #509). Tests: `server-side.spec.ts` "viewport taller than one block (#507)".
- DECIDED (Apr 2026, AbortSignal + Subscribable): `getRows()` gets a non-aborted `params.signal` (REQUIRED); returns `Promise<GetRowsResult>` OR a duck-typed `Subscribable` (no RxJS dep; cancels Angular HttpClient XHRs). Per-block `AbortController` aborted by `discardCache()`; `toResultPromise` subscribes once, settles on `next`; a guard drops results whose abort landed before `loadedBlocks.set`. INVARIANT: settle callbacks free their slot ONLY via `releaseBlock(n, controller)` (identity-guarded) — an aborted request settles a microtask AFTER a superseding request re-registered block `n`; unguarded deletes orphaned it from `abortAllBlocks()` → stale rows cached. `abortAllBlocks()` clears `loadingBlocks` too. Sync throws from `getRows`/`getChildRows` → `Promise.reject` (`loadBlock`, `fetchChildren`). Child requests (#527, `@since 3.9.2`): `getChildRows({signal})` tracked in `childControllers` (untracked on `abort`, NOT settlement — a signal-ignoring source may never settle, PR #539), aborted ONLY by the requester's `FetchChildrenQuery.signal` or `detach()` (aborted → only `datasource:loading:false`, no TBW141) — NOT on sort/filter/refresh: cancellation is REQUESTER-OWNED (Tree/GroupingRows/MasterDetail abort their own stale loads, #531); none releases loading on that `loading:false`, so an unrequested abort strands them. INVARIANT (#539): EVERY `fetch-children` query MUST settle via `datasource:children`|`error` — the requesters' only release signals. Missing `getChildRows` → TBW142 **+** `datasource:error` (no `loading` pair); a silent return stranded rows forever (unbounded under MasterDetail `expandAll()`). RULED OUT: a capability query (fixes 1 of 3 requesters); a `fromObservable` helper. Files: `server-side/datasource.ts`, `server-side-plugin.ts#discardCache`/`#fetchBlock`.
- DECIDED (Feb 2026, #400): `pageSize` canonical (`cacheBlockSize` alias removed in v3); resolve at consumption (`pageSize ?? 100`). `defaultConfig` MUST NOT set `pageSize`. `GetRowsParams.pageSize = endNode - startNode`.
- DECIDED (#273, `data-src`): plugins MAY read host `data-*` in `attach()` via `this.gridElement.getAttribute()`. No JS `dataSource` → `setDataSource(createUrlDataSource(src))` (`@internal`, fetch-once-and-cache; array or `{rows,totalNodeCount}`). A failed/aborted fetch MUST NOT be cached (`datasetPromise = null` in `.catch`). JS `config.dataSource` wins; NOT for true server pagination. DECIDED (PR #522): the URL source ignores `sortModel`/`filterModel`, so private getters `sortMode`/`filterMode` force `'local'` for it (`isUrlDataSource` = module `WeakSet` in `datasource.ts`); ALWAYS read the getters, never `config.sortMode`/`config.filterMode`. INVARIANT: host `data-*` reads are INIT-TIME ONLY — `observedAttributes` is static (`rows`,`columns`,`grid-config`,`fit-mode`,`loading`); `grid-config` is the reactive escape hatch.
- DECIDED (#369): `FeatureConfig.serverSide` widened to `boolean | ServerSideConfig`; factory normalizes `true` → `new ServerSidePlugin()`. `{...true}` yields `{}`, no throw.
- Tests: `server-side.spec.ts` (AbortSignal, Subscribable, `loadBlock`, `createUrlDataSource`, `data-src`, boolean shorthand).
